**Surface 1 (Matrix Page): PASS.** The amber "Pinned set" strip and its 4 aggregate tiles provide excellent contrast against the dark background; the amber text, white values, and emerald CAGR are all highly legible with no broken dark-mode variants.

**Surface 2 (Corridor Map/KPIs): PASS.** The 3 KPI readout tiles at the bottom display clear white labels and values on the dark surface, with the emerald accent color for the CAGR maintaining strong readability and proper color pairing.
